obligations.ask: Provide a written response about the tenancy account

results.segment: A written response about the tenancy account is required within 35 days of the date of this letter.
The tenancy account will be reviewed by our assessment team, and a decision is to be issued within 30 days.
This notice is issued for information and no reply is needed to it.
Notification is given that the terms were varied on 1 January.
